title.zh: 将甲米地省因当市镇卡伦庞塞尔卡村Calumpang Cerca小学的名称变更为Alfredo Pio De Roda博士纪念小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Calumpang Cerca Elementary School in Barrio Calumpang Cerca, Municipality of Indang, Province of Cavite, to Dr. Alfredo Pio De Roda Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Calumpang Cerca Elementary School in Barrio Calumpang Cerca, Municipality of Indang, Province of Cavite, to Dr. Alfredo Pio De Roda Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Calumpang Cerca Elementary School in Barrio Calumpang Cerca, Municipality of Indang, Province of Cavite, thành Trường tiểu học Dr. Alfredo Pio De Roda
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Calumpang Cerca Elementary School in Barrio Calumpang Cerca, Municipality of Indang, Province of Cavite, เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Dr. Alfredo Pio De Roda
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Calumpang Cerca Elementary School in Barrio Calumpang Cerca, Municipality of Indang, Province of Cavite, menjadi Sekolah Dasar Dr. Alfredo Pio De Roda
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Calumpang Cerca Elementary School in Barrio Calumpang Cerca, Municipality of Indang, Province of Cavite, menjadi Sekolah Rendah Dr. Alfredo Pio De Roda

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5618_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Calumpang Cerca Elementary School in Barrio Calumpang Cerca, Municipality of Indang, Province of Cavite, is hereby changed to Dr. Alfredo Pio de Roda Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
